answer: Trust is no fable told once and believed: each identity must cross a live canyon of negotiation, closing a small mock trade with a stranger within a 90-second window while 3 rotating peers watch from the mesa above. Judges score whether replies adapt to counter-offers, and 2 of 3 must pass. A scripted farm stalls in the back-and-forth, so 200 clones burn 200 windows yet hold zero slots. A failed slot stays locked for 6 hours.
